title: Administrative Requirements Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Become part of a winning team and help to deliver the Green Energy transition.
   

  

 For Grid Solutions, Offshore HVDC represents a key differentiating technology and a central focus for the business, particularly in Europe where Transmission System Operators have very ambitious renewable energy targets. In that context and for Germany, Grid Solutions is partnering with German TSOs which plans to invest more than $30B by 2030 in deploying new HVDC converter stations to bring Offshore Wind energy into Germany and the Netherlands.
   

  

 In this context, Grid Solutions is looking for a Systems Engineer responsible for planning, supervising, and coordinating all systems engineering technical tasks required to realize the above project objectives, whether those tasks are undertaken in house or by Suppliers/Sub\-Contractors.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a major adventure at the heart of the energy transition in Europe and have a passion to drive large \& complex projects with multi\-cultural international teams, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Essential Responsibilities
   

  

 Engineering Management
   

  

* Perform in\-depth Requirements Analysis for administrative requirements to support project needs.
* Gather stakeholder administrative needs and translate them into clear, verifiable administrative requirements.
* Allocate administrative requirements across systems, subsystems, and relevant requirement owners.
* Develop and manage Verification \& Validation Plans and Reports for administrative requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to coordinate Verification \& Validation activities through all project phases.
* Ensure the quality and consistency of Systems Engineering deliverables.
* Manage and ensure effective communication of all relevant data within and across the requirements management database.
* Supervise and manage systems engineering tasks to achieve project objectives.
* Implement and uphold ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2015 Systems and software engineering — System life cycle processes.


  
   

  

 Quality
   

  

* Advocate for the adoption of best practices in Systems Engineering to improve the delivery of the Engineering function.


 Health and Safety
   

  

* Actively and routinely promote the identification of hazards and EHS risks in own area of operation and objects of design. Provide insight to leaders, customers, and colleagues with respect to own safety and systems and product integrity.
* Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications / Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, IT or a related field.
* \+5 years of experience in Systems Engineering, with hands\-on involvement in Requirements Management, Verification, and Validation activities.
* Experience with requirements management tools such as IBM®DOORS or RELATICS.
* Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Able to work in a multi\-disciplinary, multi\-cultural team environment.
* Willing to travel as required.
* High level of integrity and accountability with a results\-driven mindset.
* Hands\-on experience in managing DBMS tools.
* Deployment of DBMS, tools and related applications for business (program management).


 Desired Characteristics
   

  

* Have experience in establishing Systems Engineering processes such as Requirements Management, Verification, and Validation.
* Have experience in the Project Management, Quality Management, Information Management, and Configuration Management.
* Have experience in a low Systems Engineering maturity environment.
* Have experience in Multiple Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) process.
* Have experience working in a consortium project environment.
* Have a strong understanding of dependability management and relevant industry standards.
* Be able to adapt to changing requirements and priorities.
* Be proactive in identifying and mitigating technical risks.
* Have a high level of attention to detail.


**About Grid Solutions**
 Grid Solutions, a GE Vernova business, serves customers globally with over 20,000 employees. We provide power utilities and industries worldwide with equipment, systems and services to bring power reliably and efficiently from the point of generation to end power consumers. Grid Solutions is focused on addressing the challenges of the energy transition by enabling the safe and reliable connection of renewable and distributed energy resources to the grid. We electrify the world with advanced grid technologies and accelerate the energy transition.
   

  

 Grid Solutions offers a wide range of products and services, including power electronics, high voltage equipment, automation \& protection systems, software solutions, and turnkey projects, Grid Solutions also provides consulting, electrical balance of plant, E/HHV substations, and comprehensive maintenance and asset management services.
   

  

 GSI GEC (GSI Global Engineering Center) in India, is expanding to support all over the world / regions. We specialize in delivering high\-quality engineering solutions across the various sectors, Power Transmission AC or DC station, FACTS, Oil and Gas, Renewable and Industrial market.
   

  

 This role involves enhancing the collaboration and efficiency between our global Regions—such as North America, South America, Europe, Africa, and others—and the GSI GEC.
   

  

**Why We Come To Work**
 Our engineers are always up for the challenge \- and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution\-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game\-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements, Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities \- including private health insurance.
   

  

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Management Representative – Quality & ISO
description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Management Representative – Quality \& ISO to independently manage and continually improve the organization's ISO Management System. The role will be responsible for ISO implementation, documentation, internal and external audits, compliance, CAPA, risk management, management reviews, and cross\-functional quality improvement within a manufacturing environment.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Establish, implement, maintain, and monitor the ISO/QMS Management System.
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards, customer\-specific, statutory, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop and control Quality Manuals, Policies, SOPs, Work Instructions, Quality Plans, Records, and other QMS documentation.
* Plan and conduct internal audits and coordinate corrective/preventive actions through timely closure.
* Coordinate Customer Audits, ISO Certification, Surveillance, and Recertification Audits.
* Identify non\-conformities and drive Root Cause Analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, etc.
* Monitor NCRs, CAPA, customer complaints, quality objectives, KPIs, risks, and improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate Management Review Meetings, prepare reports/minutes, and track action items.
* Ensure effective document and record control, including obsolete document management.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Purchase, Stores, Maintenance, Design/R\&D, Sales, HR, Service, Projects, and Top Management.
* Drive continual improvement and ensure effective implementation of the Management System across departments.



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 



* Diploma / BE in Mechanical Engineering.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Quality, ISO, or Management Systems.
* Strong hands\-on experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Essential experience handling Internal Audits, Customer Audits, ISO Certification, Surveillance, and Recertification Audits.
* Strong practical knowledge of ISO 9001\.
* Ability to independently manage ISO documentation, audit coordination, corrective actions, and compliance.
* ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Candidates capable of independently managing the complete ISO Management System without relying solely on external consultants will be preferred.
* Preferred Gender : Male.

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee (GET) - Quality
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a 
 **Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Quality** 
  to join our Quality team in transformer manufacturing. The candidate will be trained and involved in 
 **quality inspection, testing, documentation, process monitoring and quality assurance** 
  throughout the transformer manufacturing process.
 



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for a fresh engineering graduate to build strong practical knowledge in 
 **distribution and power transformers, electrical testing, manufacturing processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS).** 




  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Assist the Quality team in 
 **incoming, in\-process and final inspection** 
  of transformer components and assemblies.
* Support inspection of 
 **core, winding, insulation, tank, accessories and other transformer components** 
  as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Assist in conducting and recording 
 **routine and type tests** 
  as applicable.
* Learn and support transformer testing activities such as:
* Winding Resistance
* Transformer Ratio / Voltage Ratio
* Insulation Resistance
* No\-Load Loss \& Current
* Load Loss \& Impedance
* Dielectric / Applied Voltage Test
* Induced Voltage Test
* Oil\-related tests and other applicable inspections
* Verify manufacturing activities against 
 **approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality standards** 
 .
* Maintain accurate 
 **inspection reports, test reports, checklists and quality records** 
 .
* Assist in identifying 
 **non\-conformities, defects and process deviations** 
  and support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with 
 **Production, Design, Purchase and Stores** 
  teams for resolution of quality\-related issues.
* Support preparation of 
 **NCR, CAPA and corrective/preventive action records** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining and implementing the company's 
 **ISO 9001 Quality Management System** 
 .
* Participate in internal quality audits, process audits and customer inspections.
* Ensure proper calibration and identification of 
 **measuring and testing instruments** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining quality documentation and records as per QMS requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce 
 **rework, rejection and manufacturing defects** 
 .
* Follow all applicable 
 **safety, quality and manufacturing procedures** 
 .



  




 Technical Exposure
 
 The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Distribution \& Power Transformers
* Transformer manufacturing processes
* Electrical \& mechanical inspection
* Transformer testing procedures
* Quality Control \& Quality Assurance
* **IS 1180, IS 2026 and IEC 60076**
* **Electrical drawings and specifications**
* **ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System**
* **NCR, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis**
* **Calibration and measuring instruments**
* **Customer and third\-party inspections**



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **Qualification:** 
  B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering / Electrical Engineering
* **Experience:** 
  Freshers / 0–1 year experience
* Strong interest in 
 **Quality, Testing and Manufacturing**
* **Basic knowledge of electrical engineering concepts**
* **Ability to understand technical drawings and specifications**
* **Good analytical and problem\-solving skills**
* **Good communication and documentation skills**
* **Willingness to work on the shop floor and testing areas**
* **Positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn**



**﻿**



 What We Offer
 * Hands\-on training in 
 **transformer manufacturing and testing**
* **Exposure to industry standards and quality systems**
* **Opportunity to work with experienced Quality, Design and Production teams**
* **Practical exposure to customer and third\-party inspections**
* **Career growth opportunities in Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Testing**
* **Ideal for:** 
  Fresh engineering graduates who want to build a career in 
 **Transformer Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Electrical Testing and Industrial Quality Management.**

title: Quality Executives
description:
**Quality Executive** 




**Company:** 
  Vashini Agro Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
  Pollachi
 



**Employment:** 
  Full\-time, factory\-based
 



**Vacancies:** 
  2 positions
 



**About the role** 




 Quality in food manufacturing depends on people who notice the details, ask the right questions and follow through. At Vashini Agro, we are looking for Quality Executives who want to apply their knowledge and contribute to safe, consistent food production.
 



 You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with production and other departments, checking quality from incoming raw materials through to finished products. This role suits someone who enjoys practical work, values accurate records and is willing to speak up when something needs attention.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Inspect raw materials, in\-process materials and finished products against quality requirements.
* Conduct or support microbiological, physical and chemical testing, as applicable.
* Monitor hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and housekeeping practices on the factory floor.
* Check adherence to standard operating procedures, GMP, GHP, HACCP and food safety requirements.
* Maintain accurate inspection records, test reports and quality documentation.
* Identify and report quality or food safety concerns, and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Support investigations into customer complaints and non\-conformities, including corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist with internal and external audits, regulatory inspections and traceability activities.
* Coordinate with external laboratories when required.
* Contribute to practical improvements in quality and food safety.



**Qualifications** 




 A relevant qualification in Food Technology, Food Science or Microbiology, such as:
 


* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Food Science \& Technology.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* Other relevant food science or microbiology qualifications.



**Experience** 




 1–2 years of relevant experience in food processing, quality assurance, quality control, food testing or microbiology laboratories. Experience with fresh produce or food products is preferred.
 



**Freshers with strong relevant practical knowledge may also be considered.** 




**Required knowledge and skills** 



* Understanding of food safety, HACCP, GMP and GHP.
* Basic knowledge of microbiological testing and food quality parameters.
* Careful documentation and record maintenance.
* Basic working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with production and operations teams.
* Attention to detail, responsibility and a willingness to learn.
* Readiness to work in a factory environment and follow hygiene and safety procedures consistently.



**Why this work matters** 




 Your checks, records and observations help the team make informed decisions about food quality and safety. The role brings you close to the manufacturing process and provides opportunities to apply your technical knowledge to real production situations.
 



 We welcome candidates who take pride in doing work carefully, approach problems constructively and want to deepen their understanding of food manufacturing.
 



**How to apply** 




 Send your updated CV to 
 **quality@vashiniagro.com** 
 .
 



**Email subject:** 
  Quality Executive
